name: Kahina
contribution: An Amazigh warrior-queen of the Aurès and a religious and military leader who lived during the 7th century.

checks.lead: Al-Kahina (Arabic: الكاهنة, romanized: al-Kāhina, lit. 'the priestess'), also known as Dihya (Berber languages: ⴷⵉⵀⵢⴰ), was an Amazigh warrior-queen of the Aurès (present-day Algeria) and a religious and military leader who lived during the 7th century.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
